title: Resolve home and absolute globs on the executing machine
when: An unquoted filesystem glob is checked before a zsh command.
need: Matching ~/Downloads/Meeting* and absolute globs pass after home expansion; relative globs use the command working directory. Missing globs name the checked pattern and offer rg --files or a quoted tool pattern.
surface: Client-local and core unmatched-glob refusals share path resolution and repair helpers.
review: Source regression cases cover matching and missing home, absolute and relative globs in both hook paths, including a literal tilde directory and a home containing spaces. Live installed delivery remains unverified.
